import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import fuzz
from protocol import validate

def build(seed, big=True):
    rnd=random.Random(seed)
    cases=[]
    for i in range(6):
        c=fuzz.rand_case_active(rnd, big=big)
        c['events']=c['events'][:70]
        cases.append(c)
    req={'cases':cases}
    # enforce request-wide budgets
    tot=sum(len(c['events']) for c in req['cases'])
    iss=sum(1 for c in req['cases'] for e in c['events'] if e['op']=='issue')
    return req, tot, iss

for seed in (11,12,13):
    req,tot,iss=build(seed)
    raw=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))
    print('seed',seed,'events',tot,'issues',iss,'bytes',len(raw))
    t0=time.time()
    p=fuzz.run_child(req)
    print('  rc',p.returncode,'seconds',round(time.time()-t0,2),'out bytes',len(p.stdout), 'err', p.stderr.decode()[:200])
PYEOF
